Explanation:  
The question asks which Jason Statham movie(s) released in 2010, the year Dennis Hopper died, could he have lived to see the premiere of. The ground truth answer says "13," implying Dennis Hopper could have seen the premiere of "13." The predicted answer says Dennis Hopper died on May 29, 2010, and claims that "13" premiered in September 2010, so he could not have seen it. This means the predicted answer directly contradicts the ground truth, as it explicitly states that Dennis Hopper could not have lived to see the premiere of "13." Therefore, the substance of the ground truth answer is not present in the predicted answer.

Decision: FALSE
